ZZZLIB-BOX_GALAXY.title: Box Galaxy
ZZZLIB-BOX_GALAXY.pages.INITIAL.descript: A shop that sells [gold]W-Engine[/gold], though the clerk always thinks she's selling [gold]toys[/gold].
BOX_GALAXY.pages.INITIAL.options.BUY_ENG: Pay {Gold} [gold]Golds[/gold] to choose 1 from {Cards} [gold]W-Engine[/gold] to add to your deck.
ZZZLIB-BOX_GALAXY.pages.BUY_ENGINE.selec: Choose 1 to add to your deck.
ZZZLIB-BOX_GALAXY.pages.BUY_ENGINE.descr: The [jitter]pulse[/jitter] of the [gold]W-Engine[/gold] is enhancing your abilities.
BOX_GALAXY.pages.INITIAL.options.RECYCLE: Remove 1 non-starter card from your deck and gain {Recycle} Golds.
ZZZLIB-BOX_GALAXY.pages.RECYCLE.descript: The clerk recycled the card and gave you a good price.
ZZZLIB-HOLLOW_ZERO.title: Hollow Zero
ZZZLIB-HOLLOW_ZERO.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
[sine]Hollows[/sine] are [jitter][red]supernatural disasters[/red][/jitter] triggered by [purple]Ether energy[/purple], manifesting as ever-expanding spherical fields.
The space-time within them is [jitter][red]extremely chaotic[/red][/jitter], filled with unknown dangers—a near-death sentence for ordinary people.
HOLLOW_ZERO.pages.INITIAL.options.SHORTC: Take {Damage} damage. Remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your Deck.
ZZZLIB-HOLLOW_ZERO.pages.SHORTCUT.descri: Even at the edge of a [sine]Hollow[/sine], it's still extremely [red]dangerous[/red].
Add 1 [red]Corruption[/red] to your deck. Gain [blue]{Relic}[/blue] random [gold]Common Relic[/gold](s).
ZZZLIB-HOLLOW_ZERO.pages.ENTER.descripti:
[purple]Ether energy[/purple] [jitter][red]corrodes[/red][/jitter] your body. But you find some good things within the [sine]Hollow[/sine].
[sine]Danger is also opportunity.[/sine]
ZZZLIB-HIA.title: HIA Club
ZZZLIB-HIA.pages.INITIAL.description:
A subordinate organization of [gold]HIA[/gold], located in Janus Quarter. Operates a [gold]VR simulation system[/gold] open to the general public.
Open 24/7, with [blue]lodging[/blue] and [blue]breakfast[/blue] available.
HIA.pages.INITIAL.options.COMBAT_SIMULAT: Fight a [gold]Normal Enemy[/gold] and gain [blue]1[/blue] extra [gold]Card Reward[/gold].
HIA.pages.INITIAL.options.EXPERT_CHALLEN: Fight a [red]Elite Enemy[/red] and gain [blue]1[/blue] extra [gold]Relic[/gold].
